summary: Three candidate obligations remain unresolved. The supplied evidence does not establish a necessary harness update or complete coverage of the selected changes.

claims.necessity_reason: The old harness checks the XInclude context error code after allocator failure. The replacement memory-error helper delegates reporting, but its effect on that code and the feasibility of failing this specific allocation are unknown.

before.requirement: On failure to allocate the document URL base, expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through the XInclude context.
before.reason: The before path calls a helper that assigns XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to ctxt->errNo, which the harness reads through xmlXIncludeGetLastError.

after.requirement: On failure to allocate the document URL base, expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through the XInclude context.
after.reason: The after path calls xmlRaiseMemoryError, whose implementation is absent. The supplied code does not establish whether it updates ctxt->errNo.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The replacement helper delegates memory-error reporting.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: A mismatch in the existing allocator-failure check aborts.

claims.comparison_reason: The same document URL base allocation failure is assessed against the same old harness. Before reporting explicitly sets the checked code; after reporting delegates it.
missing_information: fuzz/fuzz.c::xmlFuzzMemSetup and its allocation callbacks, to establish a finite failure at this allocation
error.c::xmlRaiseMemoryError, including whether it updates ctxt->errNo
configure.ac defaults for the supplied build

claims.necessity_reason: The after source accepts a context-specific structured error handler, while the complete old entry never registers one. The path from fuzz input to this error producer and its callback dispatch remain unproved.

before.requirement: Deliver an XInclude error to a structured handler registered on the XInclude context.
before.reason: The before context has no handler fields and this error producer passes null handler arguments.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete before context declaration contains no stored handler or user data.

after.requirement: When a registered context handler exists and an XInclude error occurs, deliver the error with its user data.
after.reason: The setter stores a handler and user data, and xmlXIncludeErr passes them to __xmlRaiseError. Reachability and callback dispatch are not established by the supplied evidence.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Root processing enters the omitted XInclude dispatcher.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Initialization registers a generic error function.

claims.comparison_reason: Context-handler delivery is a new source capability. The old entry has no registration call, but the evidence does not establish all premises for a required coverage obligation.
missing_information: xinclude.c::xmlXIncludeDoProcess and its input path to xmlXIncludeErr
configure.ac XInclude default under the supplied recipe

claims.necessity_reason: Both versions reject a local XPointer inclusion in XInclude streaming mode. The explicit context in the old harness leaves streaming mode unset, but the reader operation may offer an equivalent route.

before.requirement: Reject a local XPointer inclusion with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED when XInclude streaming mode is enabled.
before.reason: The restriction exists when XPointer support is built. The explicit harness route does not enable streaming mode; reader behavior and build defaults are missing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The explicit XInclude context is zero initialized.
This setter controls the streaming-mode condition.

after.requirement: Reject a local XPointer inclusion with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED when XInclude streaming mode is enabled.
after.reason: The same restriction remains. The reader path and relevant feature defaults are needed to determine whether the old harness reaches it.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The explicit XInclude context is zero initialized.
This setter controls the streaming-mode condition.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The reader is a possible equivalent XInclude route.

claims.comparison_reason: The same streaming-mode restriction and same old harness are assessed on both sides. Whether the explicit setup is a target-wide blocker depends on the reader implementation.
missing_information: xmlreader.c::xmlReaderForMemory and xmlTextReaderRead paths to XInclude processing, including streaming-mode setup
